The '''Unwell Woods''' was a wooded area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Unwell Woods appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
